ReactFresh > can remount on signature ch.note: The wrapper is a Provider fiber with no reader, to check that Fast Refresh walks through Provider fibers. Stores have no Provider.

ReactTestRenderer > supports context pro.note: Asserts that toTree() leaves out the Provider and Consumer fibers. A store reader is an ordinary function component, so it shows up in the tree; there's no store analog of the omitted special fibers.

ReactTestRendererTraversal > initializes.note: The Example tree contains a Context.Provider/Consumer pair as special fibers that traversal skips; the counts of found nodes depend on them being skipped. A store reader would be an ordinary function component that traversal finds, so there's no store analog.

ReactTestRendererTraversal > searches vi.note: Same Example tree as "initializes": the Provider/Consumer are special fibers that traversal skips.

ReactTestRendererTraversal > skips speci.note: Asserts that Context.Provider and Context.Consumer fibers are skipped by findAllByType.

ReactTestRendererTraversal > can have sp.note: Renders a Provider as the root and checks traversal skips it.
